summary: Iteration 4 testing focused on Região (SP/Guarulhos) tabs, real-time search and required region field. 14/14 backend tests passed. Frontend flows (region tabs switching, search filter, region Select on /nova-custodia) all working as expected.

minor.issue: Endpoint name uses hyphen (/region-stats), while problem statement describes /region/stats. Not a bug – frontend uses the correct endpoint – but worth noting for docs.

critical_code_review_comments: NewCustody.js defaults region to 'São Paulo' AND the backend model also defaults region='São Paulo'. This means the required-region validation stated in the problem cannot be triggered (the submit will never be blocked because a value is always present). If the intent was to force the user to consciously pick one, initialize formData.region to '' and add client+server validation. Currently it silently sends 'São Paulo'.

Endpoint naming inconsistency: problem statement mentions /api/custody (singular) and /api/custody/region/stats. Actual backend exposes /api/custodies and /api/custodies/region-stats. Frontend correctly calls the plural/hyphen versions; just align documentation.
server.py line 967+ has startup event writing /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every boot – fine, but consider guarding with exist check to avoid overwriting manual edits.
get_current_user does `del user['_id']` after building response; fine, but the /api/users endpoint (line 957) has dead code (`if '_id' in u`) because projection already excludes _id.
server.py is 1000+ lines; recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, custodies.py, storage.py) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures create two TEST_ custodies (SP + Guarulhos); auto-resolved at end of run to avoid polluting Central de Custódias views.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_region_features.py. All region features working. If region required-field validation becomes strict (blocking empty), update NewCustody.js initial state to '' and add UI error before submit.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical issues detected in this iteration.
